yearValidityFlag.finding: AMBIGUOUS YEAR MISMATCH. The document is titled plainly '2025 RATES' and every date range in its table (e.g. '1st Jan - 14th April', '19th Dec - 5th Jan') is given WITHOUT any year label at all — there is no '2025' or '2026' printed next to any individual date range, only the single top-level '2025 RATES' heading. This is a milder version of the Pristine Mara Bay / Travellers Beach year-mismatch pattern: rather than a rate card that explicitly expires partway through 2026, this one simply never states a 2026 figure at all, and it is NOT SAFE to assume the 2025 pricing structure automatically carries over unchanged into 2026 (villas/small self-catering operators often do reprice annually without reissuing a full new PDF). Treat every figure below as UNVERIFIED for any 2026 date until confirmed directly with the villa or Sunworld — do not quote it as current 2026 pricing without that confirmation.
yearValidityFlag.recommendation: Contact the property/Sunworld to confirm whether the 2025 rate table shown here is still in effect for 2026, or whether an updated 2026 rate card exists elsewhere.

structuralFindings: Rates are per VILLA per night, scaled by pax count (2/4/6/8 pax) — not per room or per person. This is a small self-catering villa operation, not a hotel with room categories.
Base meal plan is SELF-CATERING — no meals included at all. Breakfast is an optional paid add-on ($15/adult, $8/child), and no Half Board/Full Board/All-Inclusive option exists.
Property is FULLY CLOSED during May every year ('MAY WE ARE CLOSED') — a hard exclusion, not just a slow season.
Five pricing periods, each with its own MINIMUM NIGHTS requirement: most periods require 3 nights minimum, but 19 Dec-5 Jan (Festive) requires 5 nights minimum.

The 15-31 April period is priced FLAT at $595 regardless of pax count (2/4/6/8 all identical) — unlike every other period, where price scales up with pax count. This looks like a short, deliberately simplified 'Easter-adjacent' pricing window, but flagged as a genuine structural anomaly rather than assumed to be an extraction error, since it was clearly printed that way across all four pax columns.

1 Dec-18 Dec and 19 Dec-5 Jan are two separate windows with very different pricing (Dec 1-18 scales $525-$850 by pax; Dec 19-Jan 5 Festive is flat $1,250 regardless of pax) — the Festive flat rate does not scale with pax count either.
An 'Additional cottage for 2 pax' can be added for a flat $100 (presumably per stay or per night — not specified which).
